newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain stops payment of 3.8 bln pta special debt.
newsitem.headline: Spain stops payment of 3.8 bln pta special debt.

text.p: The Spanish Economy Ministry said on Monday it would stop payment of 3.84 billion pesetas of special debt which matured on Saturday to subscribers who have not paid their tax charges.
In a statement, the Economy Minister said that 660 holders of these special accounts, who have already been advised, still have taxes pending.
The Ministry added it did not known of such cases before the end of Saturday.

On Saturday, 760 billion pesetas of newly cleansed black market money instruments matured. The instruments which rendered the investors immune from tax evasion charges, were launched in 1991 to flush out undeclared black market earnings.
